[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Serialize bead-store writes with SDD sidecar integration[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Concurrent bead-store writers and SDD sidecar integration in the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]same clone can no longer wedge each other: `git rebase --continue` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]is never fed a foreign un-staged worktree, a successful `rebase [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]--abort` is never escalated to `UNRECOVERABLE`, machine-managed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]recovery never discards committed bead claims, and the recurring [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sdd-sidecar` / `workspace_sdd_clone_recovery` axe error stops.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase/repos/plans/202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]sdd_clone_integration_race.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One critical section for bead mutation, commit, and [/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]integration[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]serialize[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'One critical section for bead mutation, commit, and integration' [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]section: put the bead-store worktree materialization and its git commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inside the same store-write-lock critical section that SDD integration [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]already uses, so a claim's un-staged JSONL can never land inside another[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]process's rebase.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rollback verification asserts only SASE-owned invariants[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Rollback verification asserts only SASE-owned invariants' section: stop[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]treating a foreign worktree or untracked delta as proof that SASE broke [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the clone, so a clean `rebase --abort` reports the benign aborted status[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of escalating to `UNRECOVERABLE` and triggering destructive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recovery.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Conflict probes stop reporting git failures as "no conflicts"[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]'Conflict probes stop reporting git failures as "no conflicts"' section:[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]make the unmerged-path and conflicted-file probes distinguish "clean" [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from "could not tell", route the bead conflict resolver's probes through[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the shared git-lock retry policy, and stop rewriting every event stream [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on every conflict.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]SDD store and purge the resolution cache that the user's global [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`rerere.autoupdate` already leaked into the shared plans clone.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
